selection_rationale: 28 candidates through iteration 24000. Rank candidates passing the fixed basic and held-out recovery gates by eight-seed noisy wrist RMS; report delay stress separately and confirm selected candidate survives all six delay tests. Finite simulation ranking, not hardware validation.

protocol.selection: All 16 basic trials must pass survival and recovery; rank mean noisy unforced wrist RMS, then action-rate RMS. Compare to baseline.
protocol.caveat: Finite native CPU MuJoCo tests; no hardware validation or guarantee for stronger/different loads.

noise_ablation.protocol: 30 s unforced; frictional-body contacts; identical RNG draws and seeds 42/43/44 across channel ablations

limitations: Noise amplitudes are training bounds, not measured G1 sensor statistics.
Native CPU simulator and fixed contact/PD configuration; finite seeds and moderate loads.
Wrist speed RMS includes transient/posture motion; it is not a frequency-isolated jitter metric.
No hardware commands; no policy installation or training changes.
installation_authorization: User requested making checkpoint 24000 the default.
